style: Grayscale 2D toon characters inside a modern 3D luxury apartment at night. Cool urban window light mixed with warm indoor lamp lighting. Alternating close-up and medium conversational shot angles.

never_change: The apartment lounge setting, character designs, and comedic back-and-forth tone.

facts.detail: She claims he ignored what she said.
He claims he heard her but disagreed with the subscription plan.
She insists it is serious, and he jokes about his survival odds.
He says he laughs to avoid levying an emotional tax.
She accuses him of never being serious; he claims he treats resting seriously.
He quips that he understands her criticism in high definition.
He attributes his attitude to genetic traits and poor internet.
He claims her silence judges him and equates his talk to live sports commentary.
He compares his humor to performing comedy inside a conflict area.
He promises two seconds of gravity, then jokes about surviving.
She asks for genuine respect, and he admits staying quiet is difficult.
She walks out while he claims his last remark was humorous.
